newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca shares retreat as bid hopes cool.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca shares retreat as bid hopes cool.

text.p: Shares in Zeneca Group Plc dropped on Thursday as bid hopes cooled after yesterday's outbreak of speculation of a link between SmithKline Beecham Plc and Roche Holding AG of Switzerland, traders said.
"The rumours on SmithKline have left people quietly walking away from Zeneca where some hottish money had been going in on rumours of a connection with Roche," said one.
Zeneca shares were down 28-1/2p at 16.39 stg by 1307 GMT, in volume of 545,573 shares, after its ADRs in New York fell $3/4 to $84-1/8.
SmithKline was down 1-1/2p at 807 in volume of 2.0 million, after touching a near-record 814p in early trading following yesterday's 29-1/2p rise.
In Switzerland Roche was trading up 60 Swiss francs at 9,890 francs.
Both SmithKline and Roche yesterday declined comment on the latest bout of market speculation.
